 APD-1 is professional device designed for reprogramming Hella electronic actuators used in Garrett turbochargers. APD-1 can read memory from electronic actuator and save it to the programmer for future use. APD-1 can rewrite memory in electronic actuators and also allows to modify operation range of the actuator arm, that includes changing open and close positions of the working angle. The programmer works with all Hella (Garrrett) electronic actuators with following part numbers: 712120, 730314, 763797 and 781751.

reading electronic actuator memory and saving it in the APD-1 memory

identification Hella electronic actuators and verification which gearbox number it is intended to use with (i.e. G-149)
reading original working angle of the actuator arm

618.description:
VNTT-PRO Turbocharger actuator tester

VNTT-PRO tester is designed to perform diagnosis of actuators (electric valves, DC motors) of VNT(Variable NozzleTurbine) turbochargers.

Apart from testing electronic turbocharger units VNTT- PRO tester can be used to check variable geometry position sensors.

They enable readout of variable geometry vanes opening percentage.
The tester is also able to diagnose boost pressure valve operation.
VNTT-PRO device allows you to check potentiometric sensors and inductive sensors (Hall).

The device supports actuators manufactured by HELLA, SIEMENS, MITSUBISHI, SONCEBOZ, DENSO, MAHLE.

VNTT-PRO device allows you to check:

- uniformity of actuator lever movement,

- lever tractive resistance,

- range of actuator lever movement,

- mechanical parts as well as actuator electronics,

- DC motor used in turbo actuators to change lever position,

- correctness of variable geometry range adjustment,

- correctness of variable geometry position sensor operation,

- correctness of internal temperature sensor operation,

- vacuum solenoid valve controlling turbo actuator.

features: - mechanical parts as well as actuator electronics,
- DC motor used in turbo actuators to change lever position,
- correctness of variable geometry range adjustment,
- correctness of variable geometry position sensor operation,
- correctness of internal temperature sensor operation,
- vacuum solenoid valve controlling turbo actuator.

9268.description:
Wastegate Repair Kit – Sleeve Removal

A practical tool kit designed to remove the wastegate valve sleeve quickly and safely, without the need for a hydraulic press.

Easier Sleeve Removal

Removing the wastegate valve sleeve is often one of the more time-consuming tasks when repairing a turbocharger. Traditionally, this requires a hydraulic press, special supports, or various improvised tools.

This kit allows the sleeve to be pulled directly from the turbocharger housing using a hydraulic cylinder and puller. No separate workshop press is required.

When used correctly, the sleeve can be removed gradually while controlling the amount of force applied. This helps reduce the risk of damaging the turbocharger housing and makes the repair process easier.

Technical Specifications

Maximum hydraulic pump and cylinder force – up to 20 tons

Cylinder stroke – 15 mm

Puller pin hardness – 45 HRC

Maximum load capacity of the supplied fasteners:

M8 pins – up to 12 tons

M10 bolts – up to 16 tons

M12 bolts – up to 20 tons

During testing, sleeves were successfully removed using up to 20 tons of force.

Recommended Use

To make the sleeve easier to remove, we recommend the following before using the puller:

Gently tap the sleeve with an aluminum hammer.

Spray the sleeve with WD-40 or another suitable penetrating lubricant.

Start the extraction process using no more than 10 mm of cylinder stroke.

If the sleeve does not come out, release the pump valve, tighten the nut, and repeat the process.

We recommend removing the sleeve gradually rather than applying maximum force immediately.

During testing, approximately 500 wastegate sleeves were removed using up to 15 tons of force. The tool operated correctly throughout the testing process.
